title: Path Smoother Spline
text: 使用三次样条插值平滑车辆路径，输入 2 路、输出 4 路；{Number of output poses} 指定要返回的平滑位姿数、{Minimum separation of input poses} 指定位姿之间的最小间距 1e-3、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Show CumLengths and Curvatures output ports} 输出累积路径长度和曲率、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Code，按实例取值。

ports.name: RefPoses
ports.summary: 参考位姿 M -by-3 matrix of [ x, y, Θ ] vectors

ports.name: RefDirections
ports.summary: 参考方向 M -by-1 column vector of 1s (forward motion) and –1s (reverse motion)

ports.name: Poses
ports.summary: 平滑路径的离散位姿 N -by-3 matrix of [ x, y, Θ ] vectors

ports.name: Directions
ports.summary: 每个输出位姿处的行驶方向 N -by-1 column vector of 1s (forward motion) and –1s (reverse motion)

ports.name: CumLengths
ports.summary: 累积路径长度 N -by-1 real-valued column vector

ports.name: Curvatures
ports.summary: 带符号的路径曲率 N -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Number of output poses
params.values: 要返回的平滑位姿数 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Minimum separation of input poses
params.values: 位姿之间的最小间距 1e-3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 采样时间 -1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Show CumLengths and Curvatures output ports
params.values: 输出累积路径长度和曲率 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Code Generation (default) | Interpreted Execution
